title: Onboard selene-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Thompson
body:
Context: Add initial onboarding for selene-13b v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds model metadata, curated performance profiles for common hardware (A100/H100), and wiring for automated changelog/release-note generation so that new model onboards produce a draft release entry automatically. Motivation: selene-13b is a high-quality community model that we validated against our eval set; adding structured perf profiles and metadata enables the serving/runtime teams to optimize routing and capacity planning. Changelog automation reduces manual bookkeeping and ensures consistency across releases.

What this PR does (high level):
- Registers selene-13b v1.0 with full metadata (model_id, family, tokenizer, architecture hints, recommended quantizations).
- Adds performance_profiles JSON for target hardware and common sequence-length distributions; includes throughput/latency averages and recommended batching/kv-cache settings.
- Extends the changelog generator to ingest new model registry entries and produce a templated release note draft under release_changelog/drafts/.
- Adds CI schema validation tests for new metadata and perf profile formats; fixes minor schema validation issues found during CI.
- Adds small docs snippet to registry README describing fields required for automated changelog inclusion.

Checklist:
- [x] Model metadata added and schema validated
- [x] Performance profiles included for A100-40GB and H100-80GB
- [x] Changelog automation hook implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Linear ticket linked (ENG-4521)
- [x] Reviewed and approved by infra and release engineering

Testing and validation notes:
- Local validation: registry schema validator passes after fixes.
- Perf verification: synthetic throughput runs on A100 and H100 lab nodes (see perf/selene-13b/README.md) matching expected numbers within 10% of baseline.
- CI: added unit tests for perf profile parsing and changelog template generation; all checks passing on final run.

Rollout and follow-ups: After merge, release engineering will review the autogenerated draft in release_changelog/drafts/ for weekend release. Will monitor first-week serving metrics to validate recommended batch/kv-cache defaults and adjust profiles if needed.

b4a12c3: Add performance_profiles/selene-13b/*.json for A100/H100 and common seq lengths

review_comments: Ethan Park: Left small nit on metadata description field; recommend clarifying tokenization assumptions. Also can we include the tokenizer model id to aid runtime?
Maya Thompson (author): Addressed in metadata.json (added tokenizer_id and clarified description). Updated tests to validate presence of tokenizer_id.
Luca Rossi: Perf profiles look sane. Two suggestions: document expected variance and include recommended max_batch_by_seq_len mapping. Added inline request to a profile file.
Maya Thompson: Added max_batch_by_seq_len and a short comment in perf profile JSON. Re-ran local perf and updated numbers accordingly.
Priya Nair: Changelog generator looks good. One request: include Linear link in generated draft header to make tracking easier.
Maya Thompson: Added Linear link (ENG-4521) to template and updated tests. CI green. Approving for merge.
Priya Nair: Approved and did the squash-merge via GitHub UI after final green CI.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge by Priya Nair on 2026-02-25. Commit message summarized model metadata and perf profile adoption. Draft release note created at release_changelog/drafts/selene-13b-v1.0.md.
release_notes: Added selene-13b v1.0 to the model registry with curated performance profiles for A100/H100 and automated changelog generation. Recommended defaults: quantized int8 path available, default kv-cache enabled, max batch sizes per seq len included. See release_changelog/drafts/selene-13b-v1.0.md for the autogenerated draft to be reviewed by Release Engineering.
